> **Status: pending GPU validation.** The CPU unit test passes, but this branch hasn't been run on GPU yet. I'll post GB300 acceptance numbers here and mark the PR ready once they match the reference below.

## Motivation

Fixes #38589. Qwen4-Exp (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next) cannot feed a DFLASH drafter today:

- The decoder layers take `captured_last_layer_outputs` into `**kwargs` and never fill it, so the aux list stays empty.
- `Qwen4ExpModel.forward` puts the MTP hyper-connection streams in the second return slot, which `Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration` unpacks as aux states.
- `set_dflash_layers_to_capture` is inherited and succeeds silently, so nothing warns that capture is off.

[`incoai/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-DFlash2`](https://huggingface.co/incoai/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-DFlash2) currently ships an out-of-tree patch for this. This PR replaces that patch with an upstream implementation.

## Modifications

All changes are in `python/sglang/srt/models/qwen4_exp.py`:

- **Capture point.** Each DFLASH target layer `k` is captured right after it completes. Its hyper-connection streams are reduced with `hc_contract` (the stream mean), as `glm5_next` already does for GLM-5.3-Flash (#36708).
- **No +1 shift.** `Qwen4ExpForConditionalGeneration.set_dflash_layers_to_capture` passes the drafter's `target_layer_ids` through unchanged. Ids outside the last pipeline stage raise a `ValueError`.
- **Return slot.** When capture is on, `Qwen4ExpModel.forward` returns `(hidden_states, aux_hidden_states)`. `Qwen4ExpVLModel` passes that tuple through to `Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration`. `last_hc_hidden_states` stays `None`, so the outer forward doesn't overwrite the packed aux states. MTP and aux capture never run together.
- **CP.** Under CP row sharding, the aux states are gathered the same way `hidden_states` is.
- **Cleanup.** The dead `captured_last_layer_outputs` kwarg is removed.

With DFLASH off, the code path is unchanged: the MTP streams are still returned and stashed.

## Relation to #38642

#38642 (now a draft) reduces the streams with the *next* layer's learned `attn_hyper_connection.mix`. That gives a different feature: layer k+1's attention input rather than layer k's output. Drafters trained on the stream mean need the mean, and that includes `incoai/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-DFlash2`. It is also the same definition `glm5_next` uses for hyper-connection models. If drafters trained on the mixed definition exist, a `dflash_config` key naming the reduction could select between the two; happy to add one if maintainers want both supported.

## Accuracy Tests

Speculative decoding here is lossless, so output accuracy is unchanged; the metric that matters is acceptance length.

**Reference: the validated out-of-tree patch.** It uses the same capture (mean of 4 streams after layers 5/15/25/35/45). Setup: `Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8`, 1x GB300, TP1, 3 draft tokens. Acceptance at concurrency 1:

| Task | MTP | DFlash 2 |
| :--- | ---: | ---: |
| GSM8K | 3.08 | 3.26 |
| MATH-500 | 2.93 | 3.17 |
| HumanEval | 2.52 | 2.94 |
| MBPP | 2.65 | 3.06 |
| MT-Bench | 2.50 | 2.83 |

**Pending:** the same run on this branch.

**Unit test.** `test/registered/unit/models/test_qwen4_exp_dflash_capture.py` (CPU, `base-a-test-cpu`):
- The capture case fails on main and passes here. It also fails if capture shifts by one layer or reads one stream instead of the mean.
- The MTP case passes on both.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

The non-DFLASH path adds one membership check against an empty tuple per layer. DFLASH throughput will be posted with the GB300 acceptance run. For the out-of-tree reference, see the [model card](https://huggingface.co/incoai/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-DFlash2#throughput).

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations): a DFlash2 bullet for `docs/cookbook/autoregressive/Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next.mdx` will follow the GPU numbers.
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed) (pending GPU validation).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+"""Regression for DFLASH aux-hidden capture on Qwen4-Exp (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next).
+
+DFLASH used to get no target features on this model: the decoder layers dropped
+the capture list and the second return slot carried the MTP hyper-connection
+streams. Drafters for it are trained on target layer k's completed output,
+averaged over the hyper-connection streams, with no +1 shift.
+"""
+
+import unittest
+from contextlib import contextmanager
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest import mock
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardMode
+from sglang.srt.models import qwen4_exp
+from sglang.srt.models.qwen4_exp import (
+    Qwen4ExpForConditionalGeneration,
+    Qwen4ExpVLModel,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+HC_COUNT, HIDDEN_SIZE, NUM_LAYERS, NUM_TOKENS = 4, 3, 6, 2
+
+
+class _StreamLayer(nn.Module):
+    """Adds a distinct offset to every stream, so a wrong layer or reduction shows."""
+
+    def __init__(self, layer_id: int):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.ple = None
+        self.attn_hyper_connection = SimpleNamespace(hc_norm=None)
+        self.offset = torch.arange(HC_COUNT * HIDDEN_SIZE, dtype=torch.float32) ** (
+            layer_id + 1
+        )
+
+    @contextmanager
+    def hc_norms(self, normalized_input, next_norm):
+        yield SimpleNamespace(output=None)
+
+    def forward(self, positions, hidden_states, forward_batch, **kwargs):
+        return hidden_states + self.offset
+
+
+def _build_target() -> Qwen4ExpForConditionalGeneration:
+    language_model = Qwen4ExpVLModel.__new__(Qwen4ExpVLModel)
+    nn.Module.__init__(language_model)
+    language_model.pp_group = SimpleNamespace(is_first_rank=True, is_last_rank=True)
+    language_model.layers = nn.ModuleList(_StreamLayer(i) for i in range(NUM_LAYERS))
+    language_model._start_layer, language_model._end_layer = 0, NUM_LAYERS
+    language_model.has_ple = False
+    language_model.hc_count, language_model.hidden_size = HC_COUNT, HIDDEN_SIZE
+    language_model.dflash_layer_ids = ()
+    language_model.last_hc_hidden_states = None
+    language_model.hyper_connection_mixer = SimpleNamespace(
+        hc_norm=None,
+        mix=lambda x, normalized_input=None: (x[..., :HIDDEN_SIZE], None),
+    )
+
+    target = Qwen4ExpForConditionalGeneration.__new__(Qwen4ExpForConditionalGeneration)
+    nn.Module.__init__(target)
+    target.pp_group = SimpleNamespace(is_last_rank=True)
+    target.model = language_model
+    target.capture_aux_hidden_states = False
+    return target
+
+
+def _run_language_model(target, embeds):
+    forward_batch = SimpleNamespace(
+        forward_mode=ForwardMode.DECODE, residual_stream=None
+    )
+    with mock.patch.object(qwen4_exp, "_shards_rows_over_cp", return_value=False):
+        return target.model(
+            input_ids=torch.zeros(NUM_TOKENS, dtype=torch.long),
+            positions=torch.zeros(NUM_TOKENS, dtype=torch.long),
+            forward_batch=forward_batch,
+            input_embeds=embeds,
+        )
+
+
+class TestQwen4ExpDflashCapture(CustomTestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        self.embeds = torch.randn(NUM_TOKENS, HC_COUNT * HIDDEN_SIZE)
+
+    def _streams_after_layer(self, target, layer_id):
+        return self.embeds + sum(
+            target.model.layers[i].offset for i in range(layer_id + 1)
+        )
+
+    def test_captures_completed_layer_stream_mean_in_aux_slot(self):
+        target = _build_target()
+        target.set_dflash_layers_to_capture([1, 4])
+
+        output = _run_language_model(target, self.embeds)
+
+        self.assertTrue(target.capture_aux_hidden_states)
+        self.assertIsInstance(output, tuple)
+        _, aux_hidden_states = output
+        self.assertEqual(len(aux_hidden_states), 2)
+        for captured, layer_id in zip(aux_hidden_states, [1, 4]):
+            streams = self._streams_after_layer(target, layer_id)
+            torch.testing.assert_close(
+                captured, streams.unflatten(-1, (HC_COUNT, HIDDEN_SIZE)).mean(dim=-2)
+            )
+        # The outer forward would write a stashed stream over the packed aux states.
+        self.assertIsNone(target.model.last_hc_hidden_states)
+
+    def test_mtp_streams_kept_without_dflash(self):
+        target = _build_target()
+
+        hidden_states = _run_language_model(target, self.embeds)
+
+        self.assertIsInstance(hidden_states, torch.Tensor)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            target.model.last_hc_hidden_states,
+            self._streams_after_layer(target, NUM_LAYERS - 1),
+        )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
